specialRules.ruleFull: Every special rule of a Dwarf warband applies.
Any Dwarf within 6" of the Dwarf Leader may use his Leadership for any Leadership test.
The Priest starts with one vial of Blessed Water.
The Slayer already counts himself dead, so he is immune to all psychology and never breaks off from combat for any reason.
A Slayer may never wear armour and never carries a missile weapon.
Every Zombie rule applies to a Shadow-self.
Every Ghoul rule applies to a Dwarf Ghoul.

specialSkillsList.name: Magic Resistant
specialSkillsList.description: The effect of a spell or a scroll does not affect the Dwarf on a D6 roll of 4+.

specialSkillsList.name: Smith
specialSkillsList.description: Between battles the Dwarf may buy one common weapon at half price.

specialSkillsList.name: Gnollengrom
specialSkillsList.description: Dwarf Leader only. The warband may re-roll any failed rout test.

specialSkillsList.name: Fearless (Cursed Dwarves)
specialSkillsList.description: The Dwarf is immune to fear, and terror counts as fear for him.

specialSkillsList.name: Dwarf Grit
specialSkillsList.description: When the Dwarf suffers a critical hit he may roll a D6. On a 4+ he suffers a normal wound instead of the critical hit's extra damage.

skills.name: Sweeping Strike
skills.description: The Dwarf makes one extra attack while he is engaged by more than one model.

skills.name: Tattoos of Grimnir
skills.description: The Slayer has a 5+ armour save. Taken again it becomes 4+, and again 3+.

skills.name: Fated
skills.description: The Slayer may re-roll any result on the Serious Injury table. The second result stands, even if it is worse than the first.

flags.what: The PDF says its rules are a rough draft.
The Priest's profile prints W4 (M3 WS4 BS4 S3 T3 W4 I2 A1 Ld9), read from the page's own columns; as printed.
The Dwarf Ghoul's profile row is labelled "Leader" in the PDF; it is the Ghoul's line, T5 A2 as printed.
No skill table is printed for the Longbeard, so he is imported with no skill access (William, 11 Nov 2026: stub what is missing and flag it).
The skill table gives the Clansmen Combat, Strength and Special, but they are Henchmen, who take no skill lists in our templates.
The Slayer skills are a second group of his own ("Cursed Dwarf Slayer Skills"), open to the Cursed Dwarves alone, because he picks from them as well as from the warband's table.
The Priest's "Blessed Water is common and Holy Relic is rare 6" is two price rows for the warband; his starting vial stays in his rules.
"Dwarf armour" at 80 gc is read as our Gromril Armour (150 gc Rare 11 globally), shown under the list's name at the list price. See the decisions.
A Shadow-self follows the Zombie rules, so he is imported as gaining no experience; a Dwarf Ghoul follows the Ghoul rules and gains it.
A Cursed Dwarves warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported.
No group sizes are printed, and the Clansmen have no maximum.
